```{=html}
<style>
.w095-si { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w095-si .w095-q { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.w095-si .w095-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w095-si .w095-in {
  padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; min-width: 280px; font: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w095-si .w095-in.w095-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w095-si .w095-in.w095-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w095-si .w095-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w095-si .w095-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w095-si .w095-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w095-si .w095-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w095-si .w095-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w095-si .w095-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w095-si .w095-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="iw w095-si" id="w095">
  <div class="w095-q">To decide what to look for, the Guidance points to a catalogue
  of the tactics and techniques attackers use, which connects a given indicator with
  the stage of an attack it belongs to. Name that framework:</div>
  <div class="w095-row">
    <input type="text" class="w095-in" aria-label="your answer"
           autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="type the name…">
  </div>
  <div class="w095-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w095-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w095-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w095-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w095-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w095-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w095-expl iw-expl" hidden>MITRE ATT&amp;CK catalogues the tactics and techniques attackers use and connects a given indicator with the stage of an attack it belongs to, which is how the Guidance decides what detection should look for — see <a href="#sec-09-detection">the section on detection</a>.</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w095');
  const inp = root.querySelector('.w095-in');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w095-msg');
  // accepted if the normalised input contains one of these
  const ACCEPT = ['mitre', 'attck', 'attack'];
  const CANON = 'MITRE ATT&CK';
  function clearMarks() {
    inp.classList.remove('w095-right', 'w095-wrong');
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w095-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function check() {
    clearMarks();
    const norm = inp.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    if (!norm) { msg.textContent = 'Type an answer first.'; return; }
    if (ACCEPT.some(a => norm.includes(a))) {
      inp.classList.add('w095-right');
      msg.textContent = '✓ Correct — its cloud matrix is on the reading list for this chapter.';
      msg.classList.add('ok');
    } else {
      inp.classList.add('w095-wrong');
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not the framework the chapter names — try again (it appears in the detection section).';
      msg.classList.add('bad');
    }
  }
  inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
  inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') check(); });
  root.querySelector('.w095-check').addEventListener('click', check);
  root.querySelector('.w095-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelector('.w095-expl').hidden = true;
    inp.value = ''; clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w095-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    inp.value = CANON;
    inp.classList.add('w095-right');
    root.querySelector('.w095-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.classList.add('ok');
  });
})();
</script>
```
